detail.legacy_events: data.events remains the redacted P08 representation

required: matching tenant/org dimensions when source contains them

paging.list: Existing page/per_page OR cursor; deterministic created_at DESC,batch UUID DESC,null time last
paging.detail: Existing limit/cursor; event time DESC,immutable activityId DESC; canonical scan_events precedence
paging.representation_scope: Cursor bound to v3/v4, actor,family,warehouse,tenant,permissions and filters; never reusable across representation or scope
paging.consistency: Single-response repeatable-read snapshot; keyset upper bound is NOT a cross-request frozen snapshot
paging.over_limit: 503 P23_VERIFICATION_LIMIT; never partial totals disguised as complete
paging.summary: Full retained session as of response/cursor upper bound, independent of visible event page/filter

batch.batchNo: Persisted batch_no only; null/NOT_RECORDED when column/value absent; never generate from UUID/date/list index
batch.createdAt: Source created_at, never reused as startedAt or endedAt
batch.status: Persisted batch status only; not inferred from latest result or document status
batch.actor: Persisted batch.created_by; role=BATCH_CREATOR_NOT_EVENT_ACTOR; no current-directory name fallback
batch.scanners: Distinct verified persisted event actors; null if absent; partial source explicitly marked
batch.warehouse: Persisted batch warehouse_id rechecked against current scope. code/name from authorized current warehouses directory and explicitly NOT historical snapshots
batch.fieldSources: Per-field status/source object: RECORDED,NOT_RECORDED,PARTIAL_SOURCE,REDACTED_PERMISSION,SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or more specific declared reason
batch.primaryDocument: Unique verified business document, preferred over its related warranty case; otherwise null with explicit reason
batch.relatedDocuments: Only verified owner relations; [] plus explicit status when none can be established; not proof that all business relationships are absent

events.occurredAt: Original event created_at under history-timestamps-v1, RFC3339 UTC preserving source precision; no device/GET-time substitution
events.status: Exact persisted result_status; RESOLVED stays RESOLVED_NOT_ACCEPTED
events.displayCode: Requires inventory.trace plus approved strict identifier/composite grammar and persisted code_type or HN1 marker; arbitrary raw strings, URLs, PII/secret-like content remain null/redacted even with permission
events.codeType: Persisted event code_type QR/BARCODE/RFID/NFC only; not scan_source, current physical-code type or guessed classification
events.quantity: Positive integral persisted event quantity or exact verified owner scan item quantity; no default1 or box/container current quantity
events.actor: Persisted event.actor_id; or successful SCAN audit whose entity_id AND after_data.scan_batch_id match; or exact owner scan selected_by/scanned_by/matched_by. Never batch creator fallback
events.actor_displayName: Persisted event actor_display_name only, additionally requires iam.user.view. Missing historical snapshot stays null; no current person/role lookup
events.reason_serial_sku: Not opened by this revision; null, no current lookup fallback
events.relatedDocument: Verified owner relation only; each target is exact relative GET path with same warehouse query and owner reauthorization

summary.verifiedValidCodes: Distinct persisted raw-code identities (internal digest not returned) or physical-code UUID when raw missing; exact ACCEPTED or VALID with verified owner relation. Unverifiable identity/relation -> null, never unknown0. RESOLVED excluded
summary.explicitRejectedAttempts: Count exact REJECTED only; not OTHER/ERROR/INVALID inferred grouping
summary.duplicateAttempts: Count exact DUPLICATE attempts, never included in distinct valid codes
summary.issuedComponentQuantity: Sum distinct posted component_issue_items evidence belonging to session events; document POSTED + posted_at + item POSTED + full-line scanned/required/item quantities equal negative owner ledger for matching doc/line/SKU/warehouse. Writer ledger is per line, not per BOX; only session-owned item quantity attributed
summary.partial_sources: Unknown complete metric values remain null; existing availableTotal/coverage distinguish readable subset
summary.counts: Legacy P23 counts retained separately and NOT relabeled as valid-code or posting totals

relations.stock: Batch source_type/source_id AND exact inbound_scan_entries/outbound_item_matches.scan_event_id AND matching event resolved target AND line FK -> stock_document_lines -> same directional warehouse,nondeleted document; documents.read + inbound/outbound.view
relations.component: Batch COMPONENT_ISSUE_DOCUMENT/source_id AND component_issue_items.scan_event_id,target identity,line/document FK AND same warehouse + persisted warranty_case_warehouse_owners; documents.read + warranty.view/manage + warranty.component_issue
relations.warranty: Only from the verified component document's warranty_case_id and verified owner table, never a source_id guess
relations.source_id_alone: NOT_ESTABLISHED; no URL or synthetic business number
relations.permission_or_source_failure: Explicit REDACTED_PERMISSION or SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, not empty-success semantics

live_legacy_limits: Current DEV batch tables do not persist batch_no,started_at,ended_at,status
Legacy event source does not persist event actor,name,quantity,code type
No historical actor-name snapshots in observed current scan schemas

release.fixtures: Complete optional-column example only in disposable test DB; no invented or backfilled DEV history
